title: The complex of discrete Morse matchings of the $n$-simplex: homotopy types and structural results
summary: The complex of discrete Morse matchings $\M(K)$, introduced by Chari and Joswig, is a simplicial complex whose simplices are the acyclic matchings on the Hasse diagram of $K$. Its homotopy type is known in only a handful of cases. In this paper, we compute the homotopy types of $\M(Δ^3)$ and $\M(\partialΔ^3)$, the corresponding pure complexes $\M_{P}(Δ^3) \simeq \M_{P}(\partialΔ^3)$, and the generalized complex of discrete Morse matchings $\GM(Δ^3) \simeq \GM(\partialΔ^3)$.
